correctness.rationale: For N8(s,t)=max(|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/sqrt(2)), the unit circle is an 8-edge centrally symmetric octagon with vertices ±(1,sqrt(2)−1), ±(sqrt(2)−1,1) and counterparts. Parametrize γ(s) affinely on edges with period 8 and let D(s,g)=N8(γ(s+g)−γ(s)). For cyclic directed gaps 0≤g≤5/2, 4 convex polygonal cells in phase/g coordinates cover the domain, so exact vertex maxima 2(sqrt(2)−1), sqrt(2), L, L bound D≤L, L=1+1/sqrt(2). If g=5/2+h, 0<h<1/2, direct edge affine formulas yield D>L iff u=s mod 1<1/2, or u>1/2 and u+h>1, with u=1/2 excluded. If all three pairwise distances exceeded L, cyclic gap sum 8 forces each g_i=5/2+h_i with ∑h_i=1/2; the strict phase criterion plus u_{i+1}=(u_i+1/2+h_i) mod1 forces all phases on the same side and summation would give ∑h_i=3/2, contradiction. Witness x=(1/sqrt2,1/sqrt2), y=((sqrt2−1)/2,−1), z=(−1,(sqrt2−1)/2) are unit and pairwise distance L, giving J_T=L<sqrt3. Independent exact quadratic-field checker source inspected; independently evaluated cell extrema and thousands of strict-gap grid points; continuum bound follows from affine/phase proof, not sampling.
